data.name: Lethal Accuracy
data.description: When using her surprise accuracy rage power, the barbarian's critical multiplier for damage increases by 1 (a ?2 multiplier becomes ?3, a 19-20/?2 multiplier becomes 19-20/?3, a x3 multiplier becomes x4, and a x4 multiplier becomes x5). A barbarian must have the surprise accuracy and deadly accuracy rage powers and be 16th level before selecting this rage power.
